note: Avistar (avistar) — Elysion MG Supporter, Electric, Burst I (cd 20s, ammo 300, reloadFrames 171, RoF 60). A 'king-maker' B1 enabler in the Chime mold: she designates ONE ally as 'her favorite pop star' (word_group=10103) and pours her damage buffs into it, AND re-enters Burst Stage 1 so a second B1 can also cast each chain. FAVORITE-POP-STAR TARGETING: the single ally with the highest ATK, modeled as alliesTopAtk count:1 with STATIC base-ATK ranking (no byFinalAtk — the kit says plain 'her favorite pop star'/highest ATK, not 'final ATK', so the owner literal-word rule keeps base ranking; the designation is fixed at battle start, which matches the engine evaluating the ranking once — the chime 'the king' precedent). Avistar is a low-ATK Supporter so she is never herself the favorite in practice; excludeSelf is ON to keep the buff from landing on Avistar in edge cases (e.g. scope-lock control teams where a Defender tested unit has lower base ATK than her). SKILL1 (Aftershow, 'Activates when Full Burst ends'): (L1) the favorite pop star gets ATK ▲80.26% OF AVISTAR'S OWN ATK as a flat add → casterAtkPct 80.26 on fullBurstEnd. NOTE the caster-basis: this is % of the SKILL USER's ATK (Avistar, a Supporter), NOT % of the carry's own ATK — atkPct would massively over-buff a high-ATK carry and is the nearest-wrong counterfactual (chime precedent). 'This effect is removed when entering Full Burst' is NOT enacted — the engine has no expire-on-FB-entry hook (fbGate gates APPLICATION at trigger time only, sim.ts:2030; buffs expire purely by expiresFrame), so the grant is modeled permanent and the removal is a disclosed residual (⚑1). (L2) self heal 'Recovers 3.52% of the skill user's final Max HP as HP every 1 sec for 10 sec' → heal ticks:10 intervalSec:1 on fullBurstEnd — a real unit-HP heal (icon icn_skill_heal_01), so it emits 10 recovery events over 10s (engine design: no HP amount modeled); self-targeted, so it fires only Avistar's OWN 'recovery' triggers (she has none) and does NOT feed teammate recovery-consumers (a SELF heal, unlike a team heal). Offensively inert for her own damage; modeled for kit-SSOT completeness + correct recovery-event emission. 'Removes Stargazer' (the S1 clause) is the lifecycle of the inert Stargazer Max HP buff (L8) — not a separate damage line, documented below. SKILL2 (Afterglow, 'Activates when entering Full Burst while in Stargazer status'): the favorite pop star gets (L5) Projectile Explosion Damage ▲40.13% + (L6) Attack Damage ▲40.13%, both 'continuously' → projectileExplosionPct 40.13 + attackDamagePct 40.13 on fullBurstEnter, NO durationSec (continuous = permanent once granted; re-triggered every FB entry → refreshed). STARGAZER GATE = ownBurstGate:'cast' (the load-bearing judgment, independently re-derived by the S2b blind reviewer): Stargazer is self-granted by her OWN burst and removed at FB end (by S1), so it is present at an FB-entry moment IF AND ONLY IF Avistar cast her own burst in the rotation leading into that FB. The engine's ownBurstGate:'cast' (sim.ts:2078; fires the block only when the owner is in this rotation's burst casters) encodes that equivalence EXACTLY — a plain ungated fullBurstEnter would OVER-fire on any FB entered without her cast (e.g. her 20s CD not up, or a co-B1 carrying the chain), granting the 40.13 buffs with no Stargazer. On the happy path (she is the sole B1 and casts every rotation) the gate is always satisfied, so it is behaviorally identical to ungated there; it bites only in non-cast rotations (PINNED by the CD-bump discrimination in the spec). targetStatus CANNOT carry Stargazer (that channel is boss-only). projectileExplosionPct feeds only projectileExplosion-flavored damage (sim.ts:1662/1683) — its damage YIELD requires an explosive-weapon carry (RL/explosive SR); on a non-explosive carry it is applied-but-inert (the attackDamagePct 40.13 is the always-live Damage-Up bucket). The S2 self line (L4) 'while in Stargazer status with over 25% HP → self: Current HP ▼20%' is UNMODELED (no HP pool in v1; the self-drain and its >25% HP gate move no damage). BURST (Stargazer, burstCast = her casts; B1 so the cast lands at chain START): (L7) all allies — Re-enters Burst Stage 1 → reenterStage stage:1 (the rotation HOLDS stage 1 after her cast so a second eligible B1 also casts this chain — the Tia/Anis:Star re-entry mechanic, sim.ts stage-hold; behaviorally live only when a 2nd B1 is present, else the stage advances — the real-kit no-op case). (L8) self — 'Stargazer: Max HP ▲26.4% of the skill user's Max HP continuously' → casterMaxHpPct 26.4, NO durationSec; OFFENSIVELY INERT (self Max HP does not feed any atkOfMaxHpPct consumer — Avistar has none; the anis-star e3-rule precedent), kept for kit-SSOT completeness. Her own MG normal damage is minor; her value is the favorite-pop-star buffs + the B1 re-entry, so a /sim-battery board diff is the real check. NO `ignored` blocks. ⚑1 (Aftershow removal clause, MATERIAL): the kit's 'removed when entering Full Burst' is NOT enacted — the engine has no expire-on-FB-entry hook (fbGate gates APPLICATION at trigger time only, sim.ts:2030; buffs expire purely by expiresFrame), so the sim keeps the casterAtkPct 80.26 flat ATK on the favorite pop star PERMANENT instead of outFb-only. This OVER-credits the carry's FB-window damage (the flat ATK is present during FB when the real kit removes it). MEASURED bound: the Aftershow's TOTAL contribution is ~30% of the favorite pop star's damage (FIX_A permanent-vs-removed: ada 778.4M → 598.9M); the unenacted removal leaks the FB-window PORTION of that — estimated ~8-14% of the carry's damage (the flat add is a larger fraction of the carry's effective ATK outFb than in FB, so the FB-window slice is the minority of the ~30%, but still material), ~half that of the team total. Deliberately NOT a fudged durationSec: the outFb gap is comp-dependent (10s on a 20s rotation, 30s on a 40s rotation), so any fixed window is an unmeasured fabrication wrong in some comp; the permanent grant is the transparent upper bound and the over-credit is disclosed here rather than hidden behind false precision (gauntlet: 'measured > fudge', 'a blind honest ⚑ is correct'). Recipe: an expire-on-FB-entry engine hook enacts it exactly; a focus video reading the Aftershow-icon uptime on the carry (expected outFb-only) calibrates a window approximation. Tier 2. ⚑2 (MG cadence tuple, standard): ammo 300 / reloadFrames 171 / RoF 60 are the datamine (unverified for this unit); her self-damage is minor so the cadence is low-impact. Recipe: read fire cadence + the reload gap from any focus video. TIER 2: alliesTopAtk scoped buffs (favorite pop star), the Stargazer status-gate (ownBurstGate:'cast'), burstCast-vs-fullBurstEnd timing (S2 at FB entry, S1 at FB end), reenterStage (meta-defining B1 re-entry), and the Aftershow removal-clause engine residual. Kit-autonomy gauntlet 2026-08-01.

skill2: ■ Activates when entering Full Burst while in Stargazer status with over 25% HP. Affects self. Current HP ▼ 20% — UNMODELED: v1 has no HP pool, so the self HP drain (and its >25% HP gate) move no damage and feed no mechanic; Avistar has no low-HP offensive gate.
